title: Inspect permissions
summary: Permissions describe who may read, write or execute a file. ls -l shows them along with other details.
introduction: Permissions describe who may read, write or execute a file. ls -l shows them along with other details. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Permissions describe who may read, write or execute a file. ls -l shows them along with other details.
The permission letters appear at the start of the listing. Read r as read, w as write and x as execute.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Identify the owner permission group in your listing.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not grant every user write access just to make an error disappear.
For more detail later, use this [Linux further reading](https://www.gnu.org/software/coreutils/manual/coreutils.html).

seo.title: Linux: Inspect permissions
seo.description: Learn about inspect permissions in Linux. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
